summary: Directory.Build.local.props deliberately assigns 0.4.0-preview.1 to local source packs so sample qualification cannot silently resolve an old public package. The publication/scaffold axis is FsGgUiVersion in template/base/Directory.Packages.props, currently 0.32.2; the release workflow supplies its selected version to packing. Do not infer published SemVer or choose a breaking-change baseline from the local-pack sentinel. The owning publication plan describes historical 0.32.0 both-feed delivery separately from the retained 0.32.2 successor, whose exact-candidate receiver/AT, publisher and adoption gates remain distinct. Source pin equality or release-planning code does not establish publication.
title: Rendering local-pack sentinel is not the published UI version
